title: Page 5
content_zh:
愧疚感几乎淹没了她。
“谢、谢谢你……呃，你真是太费心了。”
“你喜欢吗？”
“嗯，喜欢，一切都很好。”说不好简直就太没良心了。
“那就好。”
他冷硬的面容出现些微的软化，看着她的眼神几乎可以说是温柔的。
她也不知道自己是怎么回事，竟然满脸通红的低下头去，不敢正视他的眼睛。
正当两人气氛有些微妙的时候，纸门外又响起老板娘的声音，她进来把用过的餐具收拾妥当，又建议他们可以到楼上的露台看夜景。
褚天阔看了她一眼，见她还有些呆呆的样子，于是起身抚了一下她头顶，示意她跟上。
走上木制的阶梯时他紧紧抓住她的手，她想抽回来却被他说了一句：“不行！你会跌倒。”
想到自己接连做出的蠢事，她似乎无法反驳他。
“哇——”站上露台，她突然了解老板娘为什么建议他们来这边了，俯瞰山下的夜景美得无话可说，抬头还可以看见满天的星斗。“好、好美！”
有种冲动要把这美景跟人分享，她转头，对上的却是他定定看着她的眼神，好像那些星星再美都没有她的表情吸引他注意。
被这样盯着，乔若曦无措的不知道该把手脚往哪里摆，只能尴尬的低下头。
夜风让她打了个冷颤，她缩了缩身体，下一刻却发现自己被拥进一个温暖的怀抱里。
她全身一僵。暖是暖……可是、可是这样不太妙啊！
细微的挣扎对男人来说根本起不了一点作用，她慌了，抬起头。
不过不抬还好，这一抬，直接对上了褚天阔的脸，那仿佛像两把火炬般闪闪发光的双眼，让她想起卡通片里大黑熊要把猎物一口吞下肚的样子。
他俯下头，两人的距离剩下一公分——
乔若曦感觉到危险，她想退开，可是已经来不及了。

他的手固定住她的后颈，不容拒绝的唇覆上她的，浓烈的男性气息盈满她的鼻间，她根本没有时间反应，他就霸道的撬开她的唇，强势的侵入她的口舌之间。
她的感觉不是讨厌，而是被吓到了，从来没有过这种经验的她一下子只觉得全身发热，晕乎乎的像是被一波波的巨浪给袭击，分不清东西南北。
他的吻强势又灼热，她无力反抗也不知所措，一时间只能呆呆的任由他吻。
他的大手在这个时候也没闲着，除了箝制住她的手之外，另一只抚摸过她的脖子，她的手臂，来到她的领口，她的味道跟他想的一样香甜，她的肌肤比他想像中还要软还要滑，让他忍不住想要更多。
跟他接触过的女子不一样，她生涩又无措的模样引发了男人天性中的占有欲。只要一想到这样的女孩竟然喜欢着他，而且是属于他的，一种油然而生的满足感跟强烈的欲念就快要把他淹没。
褚天阔熟悉性欲这回事，但这种想把某人跟自己合而为一的强烈冲动却是从来没有过的。
随着上衣扣子被解开，他的手滑进里面，悍然的解开她胸前的蕾丝。人手的软绵跟丰盈让他更加激动，下身几乎是立即疼痛叫嚣着想要占有她。他的手拨弄起那细致的小蓓蕾，感觉它在他指尖颤栗着坚挺。
乔若曦被那猛烈的感觉给吓醒了，那从来没有被人碰触过的地方，被他轻轻一碰竟然就像是有一阵电流穿过般，让她倒抽了口气。
“呜，不、不要！”
她拼命的挣扎，也许是因为惊觉危险而产生的爆发力，又或者是因为褚天阔太过专注，一时没有防备，竟让她顺利挣脱他的怀抱，她抓着领口猛地退开，差点跌倒在地上，幸好他及时扶住她。
“不……不要。”
见她脸色苍白，张着惊恐的双眼看着他，褚天阔蹙紧眉头。
“怎么了？”她的唇还因为他的吻而红肿，他的手还残留着她美好的触感，怎么一下子就说什么不要？他真想把她吻得天昏地暗，让那张小嘴再也吐不出拒绝的话语。
以前从来没有一个女人敢撩拨他到这个地步然后再拒绝的，他不喜欢在这种紧要关头硬生生停下。
“请、请你不要这样。”他的强势和那陌生的激情吓坏了她，让她惊慌得快哭了出来。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
“你不是说喜欢我？”他们是情人，不是吗？
在他的认知里，情人做这种事是很正常的。
对着皱紧眉头，看起来就像是只被激怒的猛兽一样的褚天阔，乔若曦缩了一下肩。
不行了，再不跟他说实话恐怕自己今天就要被吃掉了，虽然她也不确定说了实话后，下场会不会比较好……

“对、对不起，你听我说，其实……那是个误会，你可不可以忘记那天我说的话？呃……就当我没说过，可、可以吗？”
他的眉皱得更深了。“什么意思？”
“对不起，我……我真的没办法跟你……”害怕的眼泪涌出眼眶，她紧紧抱着双臂。
哭得泪涟涟的她让他完全不知道该如何反应，没有跟这种类型的女人在一起的经验，他根本不能理解她在想什么。
她在害怕，这点是确定的。怕什么？他吗？怕到她甚至说出了叫他忘记她曾跟他告白这件事。
她不是说过喜欢他吗？不！他绝对不容许她把这句话收回。
她喜欢他，所以怕的应该不是他。
那么说来就是他刚刚对她做的事了？
从她生涩的反应看起来，也许……不，几乎是肯定的，她没有过任何经验。
第一次啊……难怪会害怕。他的脑子自动导出这个结论，然后愤怒消失了、困惑消失了，慢慢的升起了一股自责。
“咳，对不起。”他不应该没有考虑她的心情。
“什么？”意料之外的话语让乔若曦惊愕的抬头。
“我不该那么急，吓到你了吧？”
“我……”吓到了吗？是有一点，她茫然的点点头。
果然，他烦躁的抓抓头。
“真麻烦。”褚天阔咕哝道。他是个直肠子的粗鲁人，根本搞不懂眼前这个精致又脆弱的女人在想什么，可是偏偏一对上她，他就想要好好保护她，想把她抱在怀里不让人伤害。他根本从没想过自己的粗手粗脚对她就是最大的伤害。
不过他会改，他想为她改。
“咳……好，我下次会克制点，等你准备好了我们再更进一步。”
他没听清楚吗？她不是说了这是个误会，请他忘了这件事，他怎么说什么等她准备好？
他、他是不是搞错意思了？

“可是我——”
“我知道。”他打断她的话。“你是害羞。呃，我也不对，应该知道你不是随便的女人。没关系，这样很好，你是个好女人，我不会逼你。”
她张开嘴想解释，可是沁凉的夜风让她打了个喷嚏。
待要开口，他已经脱下外套紧紧把她裹庄。
“这里冷，我们下去。”
那温柔的态度让她的心一暖，一恍神，已经被他牵着走下楼去。
又错过了一次澄清的机会。
可是对着那认真的保护着她不受寒的男人……她觉得自己根本也开不了口。
第2章(2)
小小的厨房里，乔若曦忙碌的身影像颗陀螺一样转来转去，一下子炒菜，一下子把炸好的起士蓝带猪排从油锅里捞出来，一下子还要踮起脚尖去拿上方的餐盘。
装好盘，她满头大汗，可是一刻也没办法喘息，就要端着餐盘走出去。
content_en:
Guilt nearly overwhelmed her.
"T-Thank you...well, you're so troublesome."
"Do you like it?"
"Yeah, I like it, everything is fine." It would be too heartless to say no.
"That's good."
His cold face softened slightly, and the look he looked at her could almost be described as gentle.
She didn't know what was wrong with her, but she lowered her head with her face flushed, not daring to look into his eyes.
Just when the atmosphere between the two was a little tense, the voice of the landlady sounded outside the paper door again. She came in to put away the used tableware, and suggested that they go to the terrace upstairs to watch the night view.
Chu Tiankuo glanced at her and saw that she was still a little dazed, so he stood up and stroked the top of her head, motioning for her to follow.
He held her hand tightly as she walked up the wooden steps. She tried to pull it back but he said, "No! You will fall."
Thinking of the stupid things she had done one after another, she seemed unable to refute him.
"Wow -" Standing on the terrace, she suddenly understood why the landlady suggested that they come here. The night view overlooking the mountain was too beautiful to say, and when she looked up, she could see the stars in the sky. "So, so beautiful!"
Feeling the urge to share this beautiful scenery with others, she turned her head, and what she met was his eyes fixed on her, as if the stars, no matter how beautiful they were, couldn't attract his attention as her expression.
Being stared at like this, Qiao Ruoxi was at a loss and didn't know where to move her hands and feet, so she could only lower her head in embarrassment.
The night wind made her shiver, and she shrank, but the next moment she found herself being hugged into a warm embrace.
Her whole body froze. Warm is warm...but, but this is not good!
A slight struggle had no effect on the man. She panicked and raised her head.
But it was better not to raise it. When she raised it, she faced Chu Tiankuo's face directly. Those eyes that were shining like two torches reminded her of the big black bear in the cartoon about to swallow its prey.
He lowered his head, and the distance between the two was only one centimeter——
Qiao Ruoxi felt danger and wanted to retreat, but it was too late.
His hand fixed the back of her neck, and his lips that could not be refused covered hers. The strong male scent filled her nose. She had no time to react. He pried her lips apart domineeringly and invaded her mouth and tongue forcefully.
She didn't feel disgusted, but frightened. She had never had such an experience before, and she suddenly felt hot all over her body. She was so dizzy that she felt like she was being hit by waves of huge waves, and she couldn't tell the difference between east, west, north and south.
His kiss was strong and hot. She was unable to resist and was at a loss. For a moment, she could only let him kiss her blankly.
His big hands were not idle at this time. In addition to the hand that clamped hers, the other touched her neck, her arms, and came to her collar. Her taste was as sweet as he thought, and her skin was softer and smoother than he imagined, making him want more.
Unlike the women he had come into contact with, her raw and helpless appearance aroused the man's possessive nature. As soon as he thought that such a girl actually liked him and belonged to him, a sense of satisfaction and strong desire would almost overwhelm him.
Chu Tiankuo was familiar with sexual desire, but he had never had this strong urge to become one with someone.
As the buttons of her blouse were unbuttoned, his hands slipped inside and brazenly untied the lace on her chest. The softness and fullness of the human hand made him even more excited, and his lower body almost immediately started to hurt and screamed for possession of her. His hand fiddled with the delicate little bud, feeling it tremble and harden under his fingertips.
Qiao Ruoxi was startled awake by the violent feeling. The place that had never been touched by anyone before was as if a burst of electricity passed through it when he touched it lightly, making her gasp.
"Ugh, no, don't!"
She struggled desperately, maybe becauseThe explosive force generated by being alerted to danger, or because Chu Tiankuo was too focused and unprepared for a moment, allowed her to break away from his arms smoothly. She grabbed her collar and jerked away, almost falling to the ground. Fortunately, he held her in time.
"No... don't."
Seeing her pale face and looking at him with frightened eyes, Chu Tiankuo frowned.
"What's wrong?" Her lips were still red and swollen from his kiss, and her beautiful touch was still there on his hand. Why did she say no to it all at once? He really wanted to kiss her until the sky was dark, so that her little mouth could no longer utter any words of rejection.
No woman had dared to tease him to this point before and then reject her. He didn't like to stop abruptly at such a critical moment.
"Please, please don't do this." His strength and unfamiliar passion frightened her, causing her to cry in panic.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
"Didn't you say you like me?" They are lovers, aren't they?
In his opinion, it is normal for lovers to do this kind of thing.
Facing Chu Tiankuo, who frowned and looked like an enraged beast, Qiao Ruoxi shrank her shoulders.
No way, if she doesn't tell him the truth, I'm afraid she will be eaten today, although she is not sure whether the end will be better after telling the truth...
"Yes, I'm sorry, listen to me. Actually... it was a misunderstanding. Can you forget what I said that day? Uh... just pretend that I didn't say it, can you?"
His frown deepened. "What do you mean?"
"I'm sorry, I...I really can't be with you..." Tears of fear welled up in her eyes, and she hugged her arms tightly.
She was crying so much that he didn't know how to react. Without experience with this type of woman, he couldn't understand what she was thinking.
She was scared, that was for sure. What are you afraid of? Him? She was so scared that she even told him to forget that she had confessed to him.
Didn't she say she liked him? No! He would never allow her to take back those words.
She likes him, so it shouldn't be him she's afraid of.
So this is what he just did to her?
From her jerky reaction, it seemed that maybe... no, almost certainly, she had no experience.
It's the first time... no wonder I'm scared. His mind automatically came to this conclusion, and then the anger disappeared, the confusion disappeared, and a sense of self-blame slowly arose.
"Ahem, I'm sorry." He shouldn't have failed to consider her mood.
"What?" The unexpected words made Qiao Ruoxi look up in shock.
"I shouldn't have been so hasty, did I scare you?"
"I..." Are you scared? Yes, she nodded blankly.
Sure enough, he scratched his head irritably.
"It's really troublesome." Chu Tiankuo muttered. He was a straight-faced and rude man, and he had no idea what the delicate and fragile woman in front of him was thinking. But as soon as he met her, he wanted to protect her and hold her in his arms so that no one would hurt her. He never thought that his rough hands and feet would be the greatest harm to her.
But he would change it, and he wanted to change it for her.
"Ahem...Okay, I will be more restrained next time, and we will go further when you are ready."
Didn't he hear clearly? Didn't she tell him that this was a misunderstanding and asked him to forget about it? Why did he say wait until she was ready?
Did he, did he get it wrong?
"But I-"
"I know." He interrupted her. "You are shy. Well, I'm not right either. You should know that you are not just any woman. It doesn't matter, this is good. You are a good woman and I won't force you."
She opened her mouth to explain, but the cool night breeze made her sneeze.
When he was about to speak, he had already taken off his coat and wrapped her tightly around her.
"It's cold here, let's go down."
That gentle attitude made her heart warm and she suddenly realized that she was alreadyHe led me downstairs.
Another missed opportunity for clarification.
But facing the man who was seriously protecting her from the cold... she felt that she couldn't speak at all.

In the small kitchen, Qiao Ruoxi's busy figure was spinning around like a top, cooking vegetables, taking out the fried cheese cordon bleu pork chops from the pan, and standing on tiptoes to get the dinner plate above.
After loading the plate, she was sweating profusely, but she couldn't breathe for a moment before she had to walk out with the plate in hand.
